bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURS is issuer-minted natively by STASIS on Ethereum, Algorand, Stellar, and XDC. Polygon EURS is a Polygon PoS lock/mint representation, Arbitrum EURS is a Multichain lock/mint representation, and Gnosis EURS is a Gnosis OmniBridge lock/unlock-and-mint representation; their controllers and upgrade, validator, and limit domains are assessed in structured Bridge Risk controls rather than Mint Authority. DefiLlama additionally reports EURS supply under the raw chain label Everscale, which does not canonicalize to any CHAIN_META entry — a policy-maintainer-routed label pool, not fixable from coin data (verified 2026-07-30: Everscale is the only uncanonicalized label and its €1,587.58 equals the full unmatched-chain-label pool).

sources.label: DefiLlama EURS chain balances (Everscale label pool)

routes.reviewNote: Re-verified at Ethereum block 25770442 on 2026-08-16: the STASIS owner Safe remains the verified owner/delegate authority for the native EURSToken. Current createTokens and freeze/unfreeze call simulations succeeded from the Safe and reverted from the slot-3 EOA, whose exact storage role remains unresolved. The Safe-gated setDelegate surface controls native mint logic; this route is issuer-minted natively, not a third-party bridge.

Re-verified at Polygon block 92141568 on 2026-08-16: this is a Polygon PoS UChildERC20 bridge representation, not issuer-native minting. implementation() returned 0xe5c9cfa10ebbfed68ba556ffbba5a89ae9e28483 and DEPOSITOR_ROLE had exactly one member, ChildChainManager 0xa6fa4fb5f76172d178d61b04b0ecd319c5d1c0aa. Deposit minting is tied to Polygon state sync and Ethereum escrow; the proxy owner 0x355b8e02e7f5301e6fac9b7cac1d6d9c86c0343f is a 1-of-1 legacy multisig whose sole owner is the 5-of-9 Safe 0x3a635c48836e7c0b9aeb378640b0bfd516985cf5, and that path can replace bridge-mint logic.

Re-verified at Algorand round 64135657 on 2026-08-16: ASA 227855942 is STASIS EURO/EURS with six decimals and a maximum uint64 total. The issuer account is simultaneously manager, reserve, and freeze authority, with clawback set to the zero address; EURS is issuer-minted natively on this chain, not via a third-party bridge. The account endpoint does not expose its signer set.

Re-verified at Arbitrum block 495274817 on 2026-08-16: owner() on the EURS representation is the Multichain/Anyswap router 0xc931f61b1534eb21d8c11b24f3f5ab2471d4ab50. Prior route evidence observed the router-only mint gate, and the current owner read preserves the bridge-representation classification rather than native STASIS issuance. Current Multichain MPC/validator membership, pause state, and rate-limit configuration were not independently enumerated and remain explicit route-level evidence gaps.

Re-verified at Stellar ledger 63986038 on 2026-08-16: the EURS issuer account still had five active weight-one signers, a weight-zero master key, and low/medium/high thresholds of 3; last-modified ledger was 63395662. EURS is issuer-minted natively on this chain, not via a third-party bridge.

Re-verified at XDC block 106140914 on 2026-08-16: the EURS token's mint gate is controlled by 0x527e5b61bc8806059aef098c97fb36db3bc4cc63, a deployed MultiSigWallet-style 2-of-5 controller. createTokens(1) succeeded when simulated from that controller and reverted from unrelated senders. EURS is issuer-minted natively on this chain, not via a third-party bridge; the deployed token's exact verified source/version remains unresolved.

Re-verified at Gnosis block 47761362 on 2026-08-16: 'STASIS EURS Token on xDai' remains the OmniBridge-minted representation and owner() returned Gnosis OmniBridge mediator 0xf6a78083ca3e2a662d6dd1703c939c8ace2e268d. Gnosis documentation describes the lock/unlock-and-mint path, AMB validation by a 4-of-7 validator multisig, 8-of-15 governance, and daily limits; this is not an independent native STASIS issuance route.

controls.label: Polygon EURS ChildChainManager DEPOSITOR_ROLE

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: UChildERC20 deposit minting is tied to Polygon PoS state sync corresponding to Ethereum bridge escrow; withdrawals burn the representation from the withdrawing caller.
routeChecks.caps: No independent native issuance cap is claimed; the representation mint path is restricted to the ChildChainManager and the reviewed bridge accounting path.

controls.capDescription: UChildERC20.deposit can mint only when called by Polygon ChildChainManager through the PoS state-sync path corresponding to Ethereum bridge escrow.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 92141568, DEPOSITOR_ROLE had exactly one member, this ChildChainManager contract. The official UChildERC20 source permits minting only through deposit() restricted to that role and burns only the withdrawing caller. The manager cannot change its own role or the proxy implementation.

controls.label: Polygon EURS UChild proxy-owner legacy multisig
bypassSurfaces: Owner-gated updateImplementation/updateAndCall can replace the Polygon bridge-mint implementation and bypass current representation constraints.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 92141568, EURS proxyOwner() returned this legacy MultiSigWallet and implementation() remained 0xe5c9cfa10ebbfed68ba556ffbba5a89ae9e28483. getOwners() returned only Safe 0x3a635c48836e7c0b9aeb378640b0bfd516985cf5 and required() returned 1. The UChild proxy exposes owner-gated updateImplementation/updateAndCall, so execution by the sole-owner Safe can replace bridge-mint logic and bypass current constraints.

controls.label: Polygon EURS proxy-owner Safe
bypassSurfaces: The 5-of-9 Safe is the sole owner of the 1-of-1 proxy-owner multisig and can authorize bridge-mint implementation replacement through that outer owner path.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 92141568, the sole owner of the 1-of-1 proxy-owner multisig was this Safe. On-chain reads returned threshold 5, the listed nine owners, Safe version 1.1.1, no enabled modules, and zero guard and fallback-handler slots; that Safe version has no module-guard facility. A 5-of-9 Safe quorum can therefore authorize EURS bridge implementation replacement through the outer multisig.

controls.label: Arbitrum EURS Multichain router owner

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The route is classified as a Multichain lock/mint representation of Ethereum EURS; source-side conservation and escrow accounting were not independently reverified in this pass.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Current Multichain MPC/validator membership, pause state, and rate-limit configuration were not independently enumerated.

controls.capDescription: The current token owner and prior route evidence identify the Multichain router as the route-level mint gate; the complete MPC and rate-limit controls remain unresolved.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495274817, owner() on the EURS representation returned this Multichain/Anyswap router. Existing route evidence observed a router-only mint() gate, while current MPC/validator membership, pause state, and rate limits were not independently enumerated; those unknowns remain scoreable route-level gaps rather than native Mint Authority evidence.

controls.label: Gnosis OmniBridge 8-of-15 governor Safe

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Ethereum-to-Gnosis flow locks the source EURS and mints the representation; Gnosis-to-Ethereum burns the representation and unlocks the source token.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: OmniBridge shares the AMB validator set. Current Gnosis documentation lists the AMB/OmniBridge validators separately from governance; the 8-of-15 governor Safe can add or remove validators and change the required-signature threshold.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The current Bridge Management documentation assigns directional daily-limit and per-transaction-limit changes to the 8-of-15 Gnosis governor Safe.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The 8-of-15 Gnosis governor Safe manages the Gnosis-side bridge contracts and may upgrade bridge or validator contracts, update bridge parameters, and change validator membership or signature thresholds.

controls.capDescription: The mediator is the representation token owner and route-level lock/unlock-and-mint contract, while the exact 8-of-15 Gnosis governor Safe controls its limits, upgrades, and validator settings. The route limit is therefore governance-raiseable.
controls.evidence: At Gnosis block 47761362, the EURS representation owner() returned OmniBridge mediator 0xf6a78083ca3e2a662d6dd1703c939c8ace2e268d. Primary Gnosis documentation reviewed on 2026-08-28 identifies the Gnosis-side governor as Safe 0x7a48Dac683DA91e4faa5aB13D91AB5fd170875bd with an 8-of-15 threshold. That Safe manages bridge limits, bridge and validator contract upgrades, validator membership, and the validator signature threshold. The mediator remains the delivery contract and failure domain; the governor Safe is the route authority.
